review_notes.evidence: A1211-01 lists four 0473 portions on AR301, but the complete TIFF scan contains39 physical blocks, with none at D5. These are not fabricated; all39 visible source blocks are individually matched.
Native crop AR301 AA.png shows printed label ZT; preserve the visible label rather than infer AA from numbering.
Native block label reads BU, while the right-margin printed output serial is BD4. Internal identifier BD distinguishes it from the separate 2A BU terminating block; printed BU remains on the sheet.
Complete source trunk tracing confirms lower left terminals are latch feedback inputs: AU.D02→AJ.B03; AX.D06→AL.B03; BA.D10→AP.D13. Preserve these loops, not a false external input/output.
AR301 AQ-AU margin corners.png: AQ turns right from c199/r35, has its native diamond at199/r36 and reference stub to204/r36, separate from AU diamond203/r37.

review_notes.location: BU 2A / BV printed BU 2G / BW 2L reset function first glyph
review_notes.evidence: AR301 column2 part0/part1 and BU.png show damaged broad uppercase letter strokes, definitely not an asterisk. Surviving print cannot certify R. BW retains the visibly open final U; candidate0 is separate.
